Purpose: Pure DreamerV3 — reference for every HTP arm
HTP scaffold ONLY — projection exists, no aux supervision
HTP grads flow to RSSM (App. A.3)
Slim-HTP: drop projection + recon, pdyn on h_t, grad to RSSM
SANITY: Slim-HTP without backbone grads (should ≈ baseline)

Arm: • Phase 1: HTP scaffold with both auxiliary loss scales = 0 (htp_empty_projection).
•          The projection S_ψ is trained only via gradients from downstream heads.
• Phase 2: Same architecture, HTP auxiliary losses turned ON (the chosen arm).
• This matches App. A.3 of the paper: architecture is fixed from the start; aux supervision is switched on later.
• IMPORTANT: warmup is NOT pure naive DreamerV3 in phase 1 — the head input dimensions
• (feat_dim vs proj.dims[-1]) would mismatch and phase 2 would crash on the first forward pass.
• To warm up from pure Dreamer, you'd need a code change to rebuild the heads at phase 2.
• Set the Warmup column of a row to 40000 / 60000 / 80000 to enable this two-phase run.
• Baseline is not warmup-compatible because there is no HTP to turn on in phase 2.
